title: Tools
intro: Three sets of tools that make probability calculations tractable: generating functions, which turn sums into products; inequalities, which bound what cannot be computed; and entropy, which measures uncertainty itself.

items: Generating Functions (#/probability/toolkit/generating-functions): probability generating functions, moment generating functions and characteristic functions.
Inequalities (#/probability/toolkit/inequalities): Markov, Chebyshev, Jensen, Cauchy–Schwarz, and the exponential bounds of Chernoff and Hoeffding.
Entropy and Information (#/probability/toolkit/entropy): Shannon entropy, KL divergence, mutual information and maximum entropy.
G. R. Grimmett and D. R. Stirzaker, Probability and Random Processes, 4th edition, Oxford University Press (2020), chapter 5
T. M. Cover and J. A. Thomas, Elements of Information Theory, 2nd edition, Wiley (2006)
